scope: Source-only fail-closed compiler for selecting the final Motion checkpoint from exactly epochs 9/14/19/24/29 by exact standard-valid825 AEE and emitting the E0-E8 invalidation/rebind binder. This contract does not select a checkpoint now and grants no hardware replay authority.

all_conditions_required: exactly five profiles exist for epochs 9/14/19/24/29
each artifact_identity exactly matches the current config path/SHA and checkpoint path/SHA/size/mtime_ns
each checkpoint is a non-symlink regular file and remains stat-identical across SHA256 hashing
each module_counts object is exactly ATLIFTernaryPSN=105 and ShiftmaxAttention=12
ranking file declares ranking_mode=aee and its five-row order equals independently recomputed exact-AEE order
all accuracy and activity values are finite; total_spikes is positive; effective_flops is within dense_flops
selection_gate.selection_rule: minimum exact standard-valid825 AEE; lowest epoch is the deterministic tie break

e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E0: final checkpoint/config/profile identity; this binder binds it but a different-author hammer must verify it
e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E1: standard valid825 becomes bound; dyadic/quantized/hardware-order accuracy remains invalidated
e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E2: unified ordered full-network capture invalidated and must be regenerated
e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E3: C1 four-Conv cycles/occupancy/conflicts/refills/traffic and external replay invalidated
e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E4: decoder D0-D3 payload, D1 numeric miter, address cycles and traffic invalidated
e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E5: ATLIF/FC/patch/BN activity, sparsity, commits and traffic invalidated
e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E6: attention/RQTB NPZ, exact miter, reuse, local cycles and Amdahl invalidated
e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E7: real-trace SAIF/PTPX and decoder-complete memory-inclusive Table A invalidated
e0_e8_invalidation_targets.E8: weight/bias export, range/overflow proof, encoding miter and compressed fit invalidated

exact_next_execution_gate.prerequisite_0: different-author independent hammer passes this exact source+contract identity
exact_next_execution_gate.prerequisite_1: the existing standard valid825 process exits successfully without interruption
exact_next_execution_gate.prerequisite_2: profile_ranking_valid825.md exists and declares Ranking mode: `aee`.
exact_next_execution_gate.action: Run the exact-SHA builder once on the remote repository against the frozen run/config/ranking paths; the builder performs only read/hash/validate plus receipt writes and starts no GPU or EDA job.
exact_next_execution_gate.post_action: Copy only the small sealed binder receipt for a different-author independent hammer. No E1 deployment evaluation or E2-E8 hardware rebind may start before that result hammer passes.
